text.p: Framatome Connectors International, a unit of French nuclear power plant maker Framatome, said in a statement on Tuesday it had acquired Interlock Corp, based in Westland, Michigan.
It gave no cost for the acquisition. Interlock, which has 430 employees, manufactures connectors and terminals for U.S. automakers and their suppliers.
This acquisition will be merged with FCI Automotive's North American operations to strengthen its position and form Framatome Connectors Interlock Inc.

Framatome Connectors International (FCI) is Europe's largest connectors supplier and third largest worldwide. It serves the automotive, telecommunications, data processing and defence industries, among others.
